```{=html}
<style>
  .oa-filters { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin: 1.5rem 0 1rem; }
  .oa-filter-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }

  .concept-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 0.75rem 0 1.25rem; }

  .concept-tag[data-team="B"] { border-style: dashed !important; }

  .team-note { font-size: 10px; color: #9aa0a8; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; }
  .oa-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }

  .btn-search:hover { background: #ede8d0 !important; border-color: #5a6472 !important; color: #5a6472 !important; }
  .btn-search:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }
  .oa-stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }

  .paper-card .title a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
  .paper-card .authors { font-size: 12px; color: #7a6a58 !important; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .paper-card .meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
  .badge { font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 3px; }
  .badge-journal { background: #ede8d0 !important; color: #5a6472 !important; border: 1px solid #c9c0a0 !important; }
  .badge-oa { background: #e8f5d8 !important; color: #4a7c20 !important; }
  .badge-year { background: #ede8d0 !important; color: #7a6a58 !important; }
  .badge-cite { background: #ede8d0 !important; color: #7a6a58 !important; }
  .oa-status { text-align: center; padding: 2rem 0; color: #7a6a58 !important; font-size: 14px; }
  .oa-error { padding: 1rem; background: #fef2f2 !important; border: 1px solid #fca5a5 !important; border-radius: 4px; color: #b91c1c !important; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .pagination { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 1.5rem; }
  .page-btn { background: #FAF6E6 !important; border: 1.5px solid #9aa0a8 !important; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 16px; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; color: #3a3028 !important; transition: all 0.15s; }
  .page-btn:hover { background: #ede8d0 !important; border-color: #5a6472 !important; color: #5a6472 !important; }
  .page-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.3; cursor: not-allowed; }
  .page-info { font-size: 13px; color: #7a6a58 !important; }
  .section-label { font-size: 11px; color: #7a6a58 !important; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
  hr.oa-divider { border: none; border-top: 1px solid #c9c0a0 !important; margin: 1rem 0; }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .oa-filter-group select, .oa-filter-group input { background: #2a2a2a !important; border-color: #555 !important; color: #ddd !important; }
    .concept-tag { background: #2a2a2a !important; color: #ccc !important; border-color: #555 !important; }
    .concept-tag.active { background: #5a6472 !important; border-color: #5a6472 !important; color: white !important; }
    .btn-search { background: #2a2a2a !important; color: #ddd !important; border-color: #888 !important; }
    .stat-box { background: #1e1e1e !important; border-color: #444 !important; }
    .stat-box .value { color: #e0ddd0 !important; }
    .paper-card { background: #1e1e1e !important; border-color: #444 !important; }
    .paper-card .title { color: #e0ddd0 !important; }
    .paper-card .title a { color: #9ab0c0 !important; }
    .paper-card .authors { color: #aaa !important; }
    .badge-journal { background: #252a30 !important; color: #9ab0c0 !important; border-color: #555 !important; }
    .badge-year, .badge-cite { background: #2a2a2a !important; color: #aaa !important; }
    .page-btn { background: #2a2a2a !important; border-color: #888 !important; color: #ddd !important; }
    .oa-status { color: #aaa !important; }
    .section-label, .team-label { color: #aaa !important; }
  }
</style>

</div>

<script>
  let currentPage = 1;
  let totalResults = 0;
  let selectedConcepts = new Set();

  // ═══ PASTE JS SET LINES HERE (section 3 from generate_journals.R) ═══
  let selectedAJournals = new Set([]);
  let selectedBJournals = new Set([]);
  // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  const B_SUBFIELDS = "topics.subfield.display_name:Infectious Diseases|Microbiology|Virology";

  const today = new Date();
  const ago1m = new Date(today); ago1m.setMonth(today.getMonth() - 1);
  document.getElementById("fromDate").value = ago1m.toISOString().split("T")[0];
  document.getElementById("toDate").value = today.toISOString().split("T")[0];

  document.querySelectorAll("#conceptTags .concept-tag").forEach(tag => {
    tag.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const id = tag.dataset.id;
      if (selectedConcepts.has(id)) { selectedConcepts.delete(id); tag.classList.remove("active"); }
      else { selectedConcepts.add(id); tag.classList.add("active"); }
    });
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("#aJournalTags .concept-tag").forEach(tag => {
    tag.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const id = tag.dataset.id;
      if (selectedAJournals.has(id)) { selectedAJournals.delete(id); tag.classList.remove("active"); }
      else { selectedAJournals.add(id); tag.classList.add("active"); }
    });
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("#bJournalTags .concept-tag").forEach(tag => {
    tag.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const id = tag.dataset.id;
      if (selectedBJournals.has(id)) { selectedBJournals.delete(id); tag.classList.remove("active"); }
      else { selectedBJournals.add(id); tag.classList.add("active"); }
    });
  });

  function buildCommonFilters(journalIds) {
    const from = document.getElementById("fromDate").value;
    const to   = document.getElementById("toDate").value;
    const oa   = document.getElementById("oaFilter").value;
    let f = "primary_location.source.id:" + Array.from(journalIds).join("|");
    if (selectedConcepts.size > 0) f += ",concepts.id:" + Array.from(selectedConcepts).join("|");
    if (from) f += ",from_publication_date:" + from;
    if (to)   f += ",to_publication_date:" + to;
    if (oa)   f += ",is_oa:" + oa;
    return f;
  }

  function buildBaseUrl(filters, page) {
    const sort = document.getElementById("sortFilter").value;
    const pp   = document.getElementById("perPage").value;
    return "https://api.openalex.org/works?filter=" + filters +
      "&sort=" + sort + "&per-page=" + pp + "&page=" + page +
      "&select=id,title,doi,publication_date,primary_location,cited_by_count,open_access,authorships" +
      "&mailto=jackwgoodall@github";
  }

  function changePage(dir) { currentPage += dir; doSearch(false); }

  async function doSearch(reset = true) {
    if (reset) currentPage = 1;
    if (selectedAJournals.size === 0 && selectedBJournals.size === 0 && selectedConcepts.size === 0) {
      showError("Please select at least one journal or topic."); return;
    }
    const btn = document.getElementById("searchBtn");
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Searching...";
    document.getElementById("oaError").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("oaStatus").textContent = "Fetching from OpenAlex...";
    document.getElementById("oaStatus").style.display = "block";
    document.getElementById("paperList").innerHTML = "";
    document.getElementById("oaStats").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("oaPagination").style.display = "none";
    try {
      const fetches = [];
      if (selectedAJournals.size > 0) fetches.push(
        fetch(buildBaseUrl(buildCommonFilters(selectedAJournals), currentPage))
          .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status); return r.json(); })
      );
      if (selectedBJournals.size > 0) fetches.push(
        fetch(buildBaseUrl(buildCommonFilters(selectedBJournals) + "," + B_SUBFIELDS, currentPage))
          .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status); return r.json(); })
      );
      const results = await Promise.all(fetches);
      let allWorks = [];
      totalResults = 0;
      results.forEach(data => {
        totalResults += data.meta ? data.meta.count : 0;
        allWorks = allWorks.concat(data.results || []);
      });
      const seen = new Set();
      allWorks = allWorks.filter(w => { if (seen.has(w.id)) return false; seen.add(w.id); return true; });
      const sort = document.getElementById("sortFilter").value;
      if (sort === "publication_date:desc") {
        allWorks.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.publication_date || 0) - new Date(a.publication_date || 0));
      } else if (sort === "cited_by_count:desc") {
        allWorks.sort((a, b) => (b.cited_by_count || 0) - (a.cited_by_count || 0));
      }
      const pp = parseInt(document.getElementById("perPage").value);
      document.getElementById("statTotal").textContent = totalResults.toLocaleString();
      document.getElementById("statOA").textContent = allWorks.filter(w => w.open_access && w.open_access.is_oa).length + " / " + allWorks.length;
      document.getElementById("statPage").textContent = currentPage + " / " + Math.ceil(totalResults / pp);
      document.getElementById("oaStats").style.display = "grid";
      document.getElementById("oaStatus").style.display = "none";
      if (allWorks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("oaStatus").textContent = "No results - try widening your date range or selecting more topics.";
        document.getElementById("oaStatus").style.display = "block";
      } else {
        renderPapers(allWorks);
        const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalResults / pp);
        if (totalPages > 1) {
          document.getElementById("oaPagination").style.display = "flex";
          document.getElementById("pageInfo").textContent = "Page " + currentPage + " of " + totalPages;
          document.getElementById("prevBtn").disabled = currentPage <= 1;
          document.getElementById("nextBtn").disabled = currentPage >= totalPages;
        }
      }
    } catch(e) { showError("Could not fetch from OpenAlex: " + e.message); }
    btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Search OpenAlex";
  }

  function showError(msg) {
    document.getElementById("oaError").textContent = msg;
    document.getElementById("oaError").style.display = "block";
    document.getElementById("oaStatus").style.display = "none";
  }

  function renderPapers(works) {
    document.getElementById("paperList").innerHTML = works.map(function(w) {
      const doi = w.doi ? w.doi.replace("https://doi.org/", "") : null;
      const doiUrl = doi ? "https://doi.org/" + doi : null;
      const journal = w.primary_location && w.primary_location.source ? w.primary_location.source.display_name : "";
      const year = w.publication_date ? w.publication_date.slice(0, 4) : "";
      const cited = w.cited_by_count || 0;
      const authors = (w.authorships || []).slice(0, 3).map(function(a) {
        return a.author && a.author.display_name ? a.author.display_name.split(" ").pop() : "";
      }).filter(Boolean).join(", ");
      const more = (w.authorships && w.authorships.length > 3) ? " +" + (w.authorships.length - 3) : "";
      const titleHtml = doiUrl ? "<a href='" + doiUrl + "' target='_blank'>" + (w.title || "Untitled") + "</a>" : (w.title || "Untitled");
      const isOA = w.open_access && w.open_access.is_oa;
      return "<div class='paper-card'>" +
        "<div class='title'>" + titleHtml + "</div>" +
        "<div class='authors'>" + authors + more + "</div>" +
        "<div class='meta'>" +
        (journal ? "<span class='badge badge-journal'>" + journal + "</span>" : "") +
        (year ? "<span class='badge badge-year'>" + year + "</span>" : "") +
        (isOA ? "<span class='badge badge-oa'>Open access</span>" : "") +
        (cited > 0 ? "<span class='badge badge-cite'>" + cited + " citations</span>" : "") +
        "</div></div>";
    }).join("");
  }

  doSearch();
</script>
```
